rule: 1. For counting statistics prefer the per-40 rate: interpretable, denominator-aware (minutes retained beside it), comparable across players.
2. For algebraic complements keep the UNASSISTED direction: self-creation is the basketball-meaningful signal.
3. For attempt-rate complements keep three_point_attempt_rate (box-derived, independent of shot-file coverage).
4. Keep a possession-based percentage only when it has no per-40 twin (usage_pct, tov_pct).
Representatives were chosen by basketball logic and mathematical identity, NEVER by validation AUC.

missing_strategies.A_CONSERVATIVE_EXCLUSION: drop sparse_ratio_features (target-linked definedness, DEC-073), then train-fold median impute the rest
missing_strategies.B_TRAIN_MEDIAN: keep all features; train-fold median impute
missing_strategies.B2_POSITION_MEDIAN: keep all features; train-fold median impute computed within position_3
missing_strategies.C_HIGH_COVERAGE: keep only features with >=97% coverage in the training fold; train-fold median impute

baselines.B0_PREVALENCE: constant training-fold drafted prevalence for every validation prospect
baselines.B2_STANDARDISED_COMPOSITE: ML_SPEC #2 - equal-weight z-score composite of a small box-score set, z fitted on training fold only; HEURISTIC, not a DraftLens score
baselines.B3_LOGISTIC_REGRESSION: ML_SPEC #3 - regularised logistic regression on a small interpretable set
baselines.B4_POSITION_PERCENTILE_COMPOSITE: ML_SPEC #4 - equal-weight composite of within-position percentile ranks, percentiles fitted on training fold only
baselines.B5_STAGE_B_NAIVE_PICK: ML_SPEC #5 - naive mean historical pick by position_3 (simple Stage B descriptive baseline only; not optimised)

board_k_strategies.K_ACTUAL_DRAFTED: K = number actually drafted in that validation year (retrospective)

notes: 2026 is never loaded. No fold references it.
Every transformer is fitted on training years only, inside each fold.
No threshold is optimised per validation year.
Results are NOT stored in this file.
